t.why: A NATO member with no army, at a strategic point in the North Atlantic.
t.rel: It became independent from Denmark in 1944 and is linked with Norway and the other Nordic countries through the Nordic Council. It fought the 'Cod Wars' with Britain over fishing zones in the 1950s-70s. With no army of its own, it relies on a defense agreement with the United States.
t.know: It gets most of its electricity and heating from geothermal and hydropower.
t.etext: Seafood, aluminum made with cheap geothermal and hydro power, and tourism are its three main industries. It recovered after its banks collapsed in 2008.
